productionBaseline.terminalResourcePolicyCanaryModule: absent in both PH-001 baseline and RED

contractStrengthening.leaseAuthority: Server and frontend both require issuer-local provenance. Structural clones and leases from identically configured rogue issuers are rejected without mutating target, queue, scheduler, ledger or cleanup state.
contractStrengthening.defaultUnavailable: The real registered stable profile set is empty and default RuntimeConfigStore enforcement remains candidate-unavailable. Test contracts enter only through the explicit boot authority constructor seam.
contractStrengthening.invalidContracts: Boot authority rejects draft/evolving, wrong policy/profile/schema/capability and NaN, Infinity, negative or fractional resource caps without issuing a lease.
contractStrengthening.rejectionParity: Forged, rogue and stale paths compare authoritative configs, target generation/decision/ledger, cleanup registries, queues, connection identity, scheduler state and other-target state before and after rejection.
contractStrengthening.ledgerAccounting: Selection, capacity+K admissions, rejection, transition and rollback have exact event deltas, exact latest-N suffix and exact dropped count.
contractStrengthening.atomicFailure: A fresh first-adapter lease is applied before a real missing-session second-adapter failure. Operational configs, queues, producer, connection and authority state restore exactly; generation remains monotonic and the ledger retains exactly candidate-selected plus requested/draining/closed rollback events.
contractStrengthening.killSwitch: A closed lease remains authentically issued but is revoked by target epoch. Re-activation and admission are state-preserving lease-revoked results; only a fresh lease can create a newer candidate generation.
contractStrengthening.callbackBoundary: Rollback is already closed at the post-rollback legacy frame send boundary, proving finalization occurs at the last candidate callback.
contractStrengthening.frontendCapability: Capability undefined returns a lease-free legacy decision and the scheduler rejection path preserves queue, stale, snapshot and scheduling state.
